title: The Tire That Went Soft
synopsis: Rex, Jack and Gus learn why Aunt Jo's tire lost its shape and watch Ms. Pam measure air pressure in a replacement tire.
continuity_state: Before: Aunt Jo's yellow work van has been carried to the Red Door Garage on Ms. Pam's white flatbed. The damaged tire has not yet been repaired or replaced; the van is still in the garage. After: Ms. Pam identifies damage in the original tire and selects and prepares an appropriate replacement, checking its pressure with a tire gauge. The replacement wheel is ready for fitting and final vehicle inspection on the next visit; Aunt Jo's van remains in the repair bay.

related_resources.reason: Supports a linked vehicle-mechanic detail; no tested outcome claims for these stories.

rationale_citations.story_anchor: A tire holds air inside it, and the air helps it hold its shape.
rationale_citations.editorial_rationale: Vehicle tires use contained air pressure to support load and keep the intended shape.
